rules.accepted_credit_types: Providers recognized and approved by the Dental Board of California, ADA CERP or AGD PACE
rules.carryover: Not allowed (BPC §1936.1): units must be earned in the two years before expiration.
rules.audit_note: Certificates reviewed only on audit; failed audit can lead to citation and fine. Receipts or attendance sheets are not accepted as proof.

topics.who: California Dental Practice Act course from a Dental Board Registered CE Provider approved for it
Infection Control course from a Dental Board Registered CE Provider approved for it (OSHA/bloodborne courses do not count)
Live BLS with skills session (AHA, Red Cross, ASHI, CERP or PACE); max 4 units count

rules.notes: BLS (AHA, Red Cross, ASHI, CERP or PACE; live skills session) is mandatory, max 4 units count. Max 12.5 units correspondence/self-study; max 8 units per day; max 20% practice-management type courses; up to 3 units for volunteer care, 20% for teaching. Renew every 2 years by end of birth month.
